# Jasmine

> Open-source sandboxes for AI agents. Every sandbox is a Firecracker microVM with its own kernel, restored from a memory snapshot, so it is ready for a first command in about 100 ms. Self-host it on any Linux machine with KVM (Apache-2.0), or use Jasmine Cloud: $0.030/hour for 4 vCPU / 8 GiB, billed per second from prepaid credit, $2 free.

Key facts:
- Start-up: ~100 ms from create to first command; ~28 ms per command (aisandboxbench's open-source harness, self-run, Nov 2026). First on 12 of 25 metrics against 13 hosted providers; weaker on raw disk writes and large bursts.
- Features: pause/resume with memory and processes kept, snapshots and forks, preview URLs with WebSockets, headless browser sandboxes (CDP), S3 bucket mounts, outbound IPv6, any OCI image as a template.
- Isolation: own kernel per sandbox; no access to other sandboxes, the host, the cloud metadata endpoint, or outbound SMTP.
- SDKs: TypeScript (zero dependencies) and Python (standard library only); plain HTTP API.
